P.text: V3 (Slipstream) swaps in BuyBackBurnerBalancer.sol's _performSwap execute with amountOutMinimum=1 and sqrtPriceLimitX96=0, and no post-swap validation (unlike V2)
P.evidence_quote: The `_performSwap` function for V3 (Slipstream) swaps in `BuyBackBurnerBalancer.sol` implements swaps with no effective slippage protection

I.text: Swaps should have effective slippage protection: meaningful minimum output, price boundary, and/or pre/post-swap validation as V2 does
I.evidence_quote: The V2 implementation compensates for `limit=0` with pre/post checks. V3 has none.

V.text: MEV bots can sandwich V3 buybacks, extracting up to 100% of swap value and causing the protocol to receive significantly less OLAS than fair value
V.evidence_quote: allowing MEV bots to extract up to 100% of swap value via sandwich attacks
